sloka: बलस्य यदि चेद्धर्मो गुणभूतः पराक्रमे।धर्ममुत्सृज्य वर्तस्व यथा धर्मे तथा बले ।। ६.८३.२७ ।।
transliteration: balasya yadi ceddharmo guṇabhūtaḥ parākrame।dharmamutsṛjya vartasva yathā dharme tathā bale ।। 6.83.27 ।।

translations.english: "Giving up predominance of virtue, seek courage and submit to might for succeeding in action. Seek might just as you have sought dharma earlier for success."
